component.name: oh! Presenter
component.summary: Songs, bible passages and slides on a projector
Písně, biblické texty a snímky na projektor

description.p: A presentation program for church services. It projects songs, bible passages and designed slides on a local output window and on output windows on other computers in the LAN.

ul.li: Service order with songs, bible passages, designs, text and image slides and videos
Song library and editor with verse marks, verse order and text columns for more languages
Slide designer with text, shapes and images
Bible search by reference or by words, pinned passages
Import from OpenLP, OpenLyrics, ChordPro, Zefania, OSIS and OpenSong
Alerts running across the output, customisable keyboard shortcuts
